text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Morocco's image in world better than seen nationally but country still needs to advance and pursue reforms, King Hassan's adviser Andre Azoulay tells three-day scientific meeting.
- British tycoon Richard Branson in Marrakesh to prepare for round-the-world attempt by balloon.
- Doctors, engineers and journalists to attend two-day congress on protecting environment and cleanliness and hygiene of Moroccan urban areas.
- 13 Moroccans held in Casablanca port while trying to get aboard foreign vessels to emigrate illegally to Europe.
- Canadian International Cooperation Minister Don Boudria to visit Morocco.
- Moroccan MPs stress importance of Spanish-Moroccan financial and economic cooperation.
- Spain ready to accept extension to four months of rest period for fishing stocks in Moroccan waters, subject to advice of experts.
